+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TranslationRequest:
+    text: Union[str, List[str]]
+    source_language: Optional[str] = None
+    target_language: str = "en"
+    formality: Optional[str] = None
+    glossary_id: Optional[str] = None
+    preserve_formatting: bool = True
+    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "text": self.text,
+            "target_language": self.target_language,
+            "preserve_formatting": self.preserve_formatting,
+        }
+        if self.source_language is not None:
+            payload["source_language"] = self.source_language
+        if self.formality is not None:
+            payload["formality"] = self.formality
+        if self.glossary_id is not None:
+            payload["glossary_id"] = self.glossary_id
+        payload.update(self.extra)
+        return payload
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TranslationResult:
+    translated_text: str
+    detected_source_language: Optional[str] = None
+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+    model: Optional[str] = None
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TranslationResponse:
+    translations: List[TranslationResult]
+    request_id: Optional[str] = None
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+
+def _coerce_translation_result(item: Any) -> TranslationResult:
+    if isinstance(item, TranslationResult):
+        return item
+    if isinstance(item, str):
+        return TranslationResult(translated_text=item, raw={"translated_text": item})
+    if isinstance(item, dict):
+        translated_text = item.get("translated_text") or item.get("text") or item.get("translation") or ""
+        return TranslationResult(
+            translated_text=translated_text,
+            detected_source_language=item.get("detected_source_language") or item.get("source_language"),
+            confidence=item.get("confidence"),
+            model=item.get("model"),
+            raw=dict(item),
+        )
+    return TranslationResult(translated_text=str(item), raw={"value": item})
+
+
+def normalize_translation_response(payload: Any) -> TranslationResponse:
+    if isinstance(payload, TranslationResponse):
+        return payload
+
+    if isinstance(payload, dict):
+        translations_value = (
+            payload.get("translations")
+            or payload.get("data")
+            or payload.get("results")
+            or payload.get("translation")
+            or payload.get("translated_text")
+        )
+
+        if translations_value is None:
+            translations = []
+        elif isinstance(translations_value, list):
+            translations = [_coerce_translation_result(item) for item in translations_value]
+        else:
+            translations = [_coerce_translation_result(translations_value)]
+
+        request_id = payload.get("request_id") or payload.get("id") or payload.get("job_id")
+        return TranslationResponse(translations=translations, request_id=request_id, raw=dict(payload))
+
+    if isinstance(payload, list):
+        return TranslationResponse(translations=[_coerce_translation_result(item) for item in payload], raw={"data": payload})
+
+    return TranslationResponse(translations=[_coerce_translation_result(payload)], raw={"value": payload})
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TranslationConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    endpoint: str = "https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2"
+    timeout: float = 30.0
+    source_language: Optional[str] = None
+    target_language: str = "en"
+    format: str = "text"
+
+
+def load_translation_config() -> TranslationConfig:
+    api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS") or ""
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("Missing GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS")
+    return TranslationConfig(
+        api_key=api_key,
+        endpoint=os.getenv("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_ENDPOINT", "https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2"),
+        timeout=float(os.getenv("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_TIMEOUT", "30")),
+        source_language=os.getenv("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_SOURCE_LANGUAGE"),
+        target_language=os.getenv("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_TARGET_LANGUAGE", "en"),
+        format=os.getenv("GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_FORMAT", "text"),
+    )
+
+
+class TranslationClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[TranslationConfig] = None):
+        self.config = config or load_translation_config()
+
+    def translate(self, text: str, target_language: Optional[str] = None, source_language: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+        if not text:
+            return ""
+        params: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "q": text,
+            "target": target_language or self.config.target_language,
+            "format": self.config.format,
+        }
+        if source_language or self.config.source_language:
+            params["source"] = source_language or self.config.source_language
+        headers = {"X-goog-api-key": self.config.api_key}
+        response = requests.post(self.config.endpoint, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=self.config.timeout)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        data = response.json()
+        return data["data"]["translations"][0]["translatedText"]
+
+
+def get_translation_client() -> TranslationClient:
+    return TranslationClient()
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _translate_text(client: OpenAI, text: str, target_language: str) -> str:
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Translate the user's text into the target language. Return only the translation.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": f"Target language: {target_language}\nText: {text}",
+            },
+        ],
+    )
+    return response.output_text.strip()
+
+
+def translate_dictionary_values(data: Dict[str, Any], target_language: str = "Spanish") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
+
+    def translate_value(value: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            return {k: translate_value(v) for k, v in value.items()}
+        if isinstance(value, list):
+            return [translate_value(item) for item in value]
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            return _translate_text(client, value, target_language)
+        return value
+
+    return {key: translate_value(value) for key, value in data.items()}
